subject: website
name: Swapr
summary: Swapr's exchange app, open source (GPL-3.0); its README names swapr.eth as where releases are published. It is not Level 3: when it opens it loads Fathom's analytics script. It also reads from many endpoints at once: Infura and other RPCs, LI.FI, The Graph, Etherscan, token lists and an unpkg script host.
